meta.title: Enhance in-memory file system functionality
meta.body_summary: Introduce MemoryFileSystem for in-memory, serializable file storage to avoid disk I/O, enable agent state persistence, and create temporary files only when needed for attachments.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor bot review identified backward-compatibility bug in _set_file_system ignoring path param; PR closed without merge or numeric perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 425 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium change. The main addition is a new in-memory file system module (241 lines) with minimal integration tweaks. As a moderate performance refactor, it was closed without merge after a bot flagged a backward-compatibility bug.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot review flagged that _set_file_system method ignores the provided file_system_path parameter, always initializing in-memory from self.state.file_system, which silently breaks disk-based file system usage and ignores the caller's intent.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster file operations by eliminating disk I/O with in-memory storage.
review_details.rejection_signals: Bot review flagged backward-compatibility bug; PR author closed the PR 3.5 minutes after bot review without any follow-up commits or human review.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent introduced a new feature (in-memory filesystem) but overlooked the parameter semantics in the service initialization, breaking the existing disk-based path functionality. This reflects a boundary in handling API backward compatibility during internal refactoring.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot static analysis identified that `_set_file_system` ignores `file_system_path` parameter.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI agent task evaluation ran (2/3 pass) but did not evaluate file system performance or this specific change.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing, profiler outputs, or workload description; only narrative claim of faster file operations.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After cursor bot identified backward-compatibility bug, the PR author closed the PR within 3.5 minutes without attempting a fix.

core_change_summary.description: Added MemoryFileSystem class in browser_use/filesystem/memory_file_system.py using a dictionary for in-memory file storage; integrated it into AgentState via agent/views.py and agent/service.py; updated controller/service.py to use materialize_files() for attachments; added MEMORY_FILESYSTEM_PR.md documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: browser_use/agent/service.py was modified to initialize the in-memory file system but introduced the bug of ignoring the file_system_path parameter.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding MemoryFileSystem, integrating it into AgentState and controller, and providing documentation; no iterative changes.

review_signals.summary: Flagged that _set_file_system ignores the file_system_path parameter, breaking backward compatibility for disk-based paths.
cubic reviewed 5 files and found no issues.
